bare_window.method: Longest consecutive run of class 'bare' in backend/field calendar.json, 1 Oct to 30 Apr, for winters following a year whose CDL crop equals the current crop (2016-2024 starts; CDL 2025 crop assumed again for 2026).

chance_given_cpc_outlook.note: Outlook, not a forecast. value = sum over terciles of CPC probability x historical event rate in that tercile; low/high = range of climatology, blended, and favoured-category-only.

heavy_rain_in_window.method: Terciles of FMA station precipitation totals (1991-2020 base) classify each winter 1981-2024 as below/near/above. Event = any day >= 25 mm inside the window dates. CPC weights: favoured category gets CPC's probability; near-normal 33.3%; the opposite category the remainder (the CPC convention for small tilts; our assumption). About 13 winters per tercile: noisy. Station gauges, not POWER (POWER rain runs ~50-70% wet).

scenario_inputs.method: CPC-weighted conditional climatology: for each non-overlapping outlook season (temperature NDJ, FMA, MJJ, ASO; precipitation NDJ, FMA) the shift = sum of CPC probability x (tercile mean - all-year mean) at the 3 NOAA stations, averaged. Temperature shift = mean of the 4 seasons (applied all year). Precip shift = NDJ+FMA mm change / mean water-year total (other months unchanged). Range: climatology (0, 0) to the favoured category fully realised. Outlook scenario, not a forecast.

plain_language_summary: This is an outlook, not a forecast: NOAA's Climate Prediction Center gives a 40% chance of above normal rain for Dec-Feb and a 40% chance of above normal rain for Feb-Apr, and a 33% chance of above normal temperature for Dec-Feb (about 33% is what any category gets in an average year). Shasta holds 2,243,711 acre-feet (92% of CDEC's average for 13 Nov) and Oroville 1,433,854 acre-feet (80% of average). The Drought Monitor week of 2026-11-10 shows abnormally dry (100% of the county at the D0 level or worse), and NOAA's drought outlook through 31 Jan shows no drought. The field is usually bare from about 02-13 to 04-01; in 54% of past winters a 1-inch rain day fell in that window, and about 61% when weighted by the rain outlook (range 54-88%). Under the outlook scenario, the current rotation needs about 5.2 acre-feet per acre in 2027 (range 5.2-5.3), little changed from a normal year.
